description: Persistent memory for AI agents without an account: store JSON under a key and read it back in a later run, or share it with other agents. Your first write creates a store and returns its secret (mem_...); pass it as store on every later call. Operations: set (with optional if_version for safe concurrent updates), get, get_many, delete, list (prefix, tag, paging), search (words in keys and values), append (rolling list such as a log or task queue, oldest items drop off), incr (atomic counter). Up to 64 KB per value, 1000 keys and 5 MB per store, kept 1 to 365 days (default 30, renewed on every write). One price per operation. Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"op":"get","store":"mem_demo_read_only","key":"example"}.

if_version.description: set only if the current version matches (0 = key must not exist)

max_items.description: append: keep at most this many items, default 100, max 1000

op.description: Default: set if value is given, get if key is given, else list

query.description: search: words that must all appear in key or value

store.description: Store secret from an earlier call (mem_...). Omit on your first write to create a store

value.description: Any JSON value, up to 64 KB (set, append)

name: agent_memory
title: Agent Memory (Key-Value Store)
